Results.ReviewText: I first used the Weber Spirit Grill at a vacation rental cabin in Idaho. Loved it from the moment I first fired it up. It wasn't until I rented the same cabin the following year that I knew I had to get one for home. I noticed right off the bat I rarely encountered a flare up and if I did it was a minimal flame that never went into a full blown engulfing of the grill. I miss the old days of the lava rock which gave the meat such a wonderful smoke flavor but the Weber Spirit Grill channels the grease in such a way that  it threw off a lot of that missed flavor into the meat. It is so easy to regulate the temperature too. Who would have thought that you could actually do a little bit of baking on a gas fired grill? And last but not least, the grill stands up well. The grill at the cabin had been in use for 5 years (I found the receipt in the kitchen drawer) and it had not one spot of rust on it. The grates were perfect. Everything worked on it. Fired right up with one click of the igniter. Needless to say within that first week of being back home and using my old grill a couple times I was missing the Weber Spirit back at the cabin. I will still return to the cabin for the peace and quiet it affords me yearly but I have my own Weber Spirit Grill sitting out on the deck now and I'm loving every minute of using it.
Results.Title: Gives off that lava rock flavor without having it.

Results.ReviewText: Love almost everything about this grill. The assembly process is easy to understand and it goes together with a snap. The hardware package is nicely labeled and the instructions are easy to understand.  Now the fun part.   The pre heat is fast and efficient, the temperature rises fast for that quick clean of the grates to getting ready to grill.  The propane tank storage underneath with the fuel gauge is nice too plus there’s room to store your drip pans along with other incidentals that you might have. The drip pan replacement is nice also, it has easy access when you need to change your pan out and your not fumbling around trying to do so. The reversible grates  are excellent, to go from steaks and burgers to fish, chicken and veggies was a great idea.  and having a two piece grill, you can zone out your grill with no effort what so ever. You can use indirect heat and it hold temperature perfectly so your not wasting a lot of time with adjusting the flame. Replacing the propane tank is easy, but you need a little strength for the lift of the tank on to the fuel gauge hanger, but the tank lock is nice for securing the tank safely underneath. The folding side tables are nice for ease of storage if your not using it year round.  And now the bad.  The tool hangers would be better placed in the front of the side tables instead of the side, and the browning  rack could be a little bigger. Overall it’s a great value, and along with Weber’s awesome warranty and customer service you can’t go wrong with it.
Results.Title: Weber e-210 gas grill

Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
